7 October 2025 Judgment reserved.
Dedar Singh Gill J:
1 This is a tragic case. The accused has been charged for murder under s 300(c) of the Penal Code (Cap 224, 2008 Rev Ed). She raises defences that fail.
2 The accused faces a charge under s 300(c) of the Penal Code for killing the deceased on 15 July 2021. See [2024] SGCA 12 for the relevant framework.
Background facts
3 The charge against the accused reads as follows:
That you, NGUYEN NGOC GIAU, did commit murder by causing the death of one Cho Wang Keung.
4 The accused is a 43-year-old Vietnamese national.
Foot Note 1
 Agreed Statement of Facts at para 1.
The deceased was 51 years old when he died.
My findings
5 The appeal is dismissed and the conviction is upheld.
Ms Prosecution for the Public Prosecutor; Mr Defence for the Accused.
